column1: # The colour of each speaker's name in the subtitles (findings/63 s.26).
# <speaker's English name, as written in en.tsv> TAB <#RRGGBB>
# One list for every language: a translated name takes the colour of the
# English name at the same place in en.tsv. A name not listed here stays in
# the menus' yellow (#FFD940), as does every name with Options ->
# Accessibility -> Character Colours off. Colours are picked to read on the
# dark box and on the picture with the letters' black outline.
# A line "folder:<voice folder>" colours a voice line by the folder its
# sound comes from (the folder's trailing digits dropped: folder:labrat =
# labrat1 ... labrat6), when its speaker's name isn't listed: for the
# common enemies' lines, which have no speaker names in the text files yet.
# The common enemies, by voice folder (six voices per kind): bratgirl =
# Brat Girls, labrat = Ratnicians, znu = Znu, monkey = Doom Monkeys,
# slappe = Slap-E (the names of the game's own defeat-count achievements).
